description: Repairs r-sql-1/b-parameters: [p], [P] and the unused pA were never assigned. Asks, on a temporary QueryDef, what an assigned value does for the undeclared [p]/[P] pair (SELECT id FROM L WHERE id = [p] OR id = [P] + 1), assigned 2 through the one parameter '[p]', and for the declared but unused pA Long (SELECT id FROM L), assigned 1: Parameters read, value assigned and read back, open read; each also opened first without an assignment. Fixture r-fix-expr-sql-sql1 is opened read-only through DAO.DBEngine.120; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field. Each statement is preceded by a marker (a DROP TABLE of a table that does not exist, which always fails), so DBEngine.Errors read after the statement shows that statement's own failure or the marker's, never an older one. Where Field Precision and Scale are read, the recordset is first positioned on its first row (MoveFirst) and DecimalPlaces is not read.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-expr-sql probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
